rfm_tuples.M_value: CONFIRMED. Track record: (i) IH WAKIX Phase 3 — FAILED statistical significance in randomized withdrawal, RTF Feb 2025; (ii) Pediatric cataplexy sNDA — REJECTED June 2024, resubmitted Q3 2025, finally approved Feb 2026. The label-expansion pitch now bets on TEMPO (PWS Phase 3, data not until later), DM1 Phase 3, ONSTRIDE1 (Pitolisant HD narcolepsy, topline 2027), ONSTRIDE2 (Pitolisant HD IH — same indication that already failed once), Pitolisant GR (NDA Q2 2026, PDUFA Q1 2027), and EPX-100 Phase 3 (Dravet/LGS, Epygenix acquisition). The market is being asked to underwrite a 6-readout pipeline after two consecutive failures in the historically tractable indications, AND the IH program is being reattempted with a higher-dose formulation rather than a different mechanism.
rfm_tuples.interpretation: The clinical track record argues against forward extrapolation. The pediatric-cataplexy approval (Feb 2026) is positive but was a do-over for a previously rejected sNDA. The IH RTF is more material — it is the indication closest to narcolepsy mechanistically, and the placebo-controlled withdrawal failed. Retrying with Pitolisant HD is a dose escalation, not a mechanism change. The pipeline as presented combines a single approved drug with 5+ contingent readouts before July 2030 generic entry, which is the implicit terminal date.

rfm_tuples.R: Lupin will have a license to sell its generic product beginning July 2030 if WAKIX receives pediatric exclusivity, or earlier under certain circumstances... [same conditional language for Novugen, Novitium, Zenara] (10-Q Item 1 Legal Proceedings)
rfm_tuples.f: Mode-B: the July 2030 generic-entry date is conditional on WAKIX receiving pediatric exclusivity. Verify whether HRMY actually has pediatric exclusivity yet, or whether it is still aspirational and dependent on the TEMPO PWS Phase 3 data + the recently-approved pediatric cataplexy indication.
rfm_tuples.M_value: Implied but not explicit: WAKIX does NOT yet hold pediatric exclusivity as of the 10-K. The 10-K says 'We remain committed to obtaining pediatric exclusivity' and 'The initiation of the PWS Phase 3 registrational trial, the TEMPO study, and the data in pediatric narcolepsy are supportive of our efforts in obtaining pediatric exclusivity.' Pediatric exclusivity (6 months) attaches under FDA Modernization Act §505A only upon completion of an FDA-requested pediatric study that meets the Written Request criteria. The Feb 2026 pediatric-cataplexy approval is a necessary but not sufficient step. The settlement language 'beginning July 2030 if WAKIX receives pediatric exclusivity, or earlier under certain circumstances' means that without pediatric exclusivity, generic entry could be in January 2030 (i.e., 6 months earlier) — and the 'earlier under certain circumstances' clause is opaque.
rfm_tuples.interpretation: Mode-B finding the issuer obscures: the July 2030 patent-cliff date that everyone trades the equity off of is conditional on a pediatric exclusivity grant that does not exist yet. Without it, the cliff moves to January 2030. The pediatric exclusivity depends on the PWS TEMPO study reading out and being acceptable to FDA as a pediatric Written Request response — a multi-year, contingent outcome. This is a 6-month asymmetric risk on the entire terminal value, and the language is buried in legal proceedings.

summary: HRMY shows a paradox: solid WAKIX growth (+16.6% Q1), $711M net cash, profitable, pediatric cataplexy just approved — yet -25.6% drawdown and ZERO open-market insider purchases across 17 months and 47 Form 4s. The most material findings are Mode-B: (a) the Form 4 record is unambiguously asymmetric — 21 sales / 0 purchases by every named officer; (b) the $32M Q1 IPR&D spike is structured settlements with ANDA filers Novitium and MSN, recharacterized as 'novel formulation' licenses; (c) the July 2030 generic-entry date is conditional on pediatric exclusivity that doesn't yet exist; (d) 28% say-on-pay against and 46% director-Wicki withhold signal institutional revolt; (e) departing CFO sold $3.1M pre-resignation and the replacement is a small-biotech CFO. The franchise is genuine but management is signaling neither confidence (no buys) nor durable post-2030 economics. Verdict: SHORT-tier (lean) — the equity prices in a clean LOE in mid-2030, but Mode-B evidence suggests both insiders and institutional shareholders see further downside risk.
verdict: SHORT-tier (lean) — composite ~0.30; key driver is the absent buy-signal across 17 months at -25.6% drawdown combined with ANDA-payoff licenses obscured as IPR&D and the conditional July 2030 cliff.
